 First round of November Social Security payments goes out in three days.
 By Britta Miller 
 Published
 November 7, 2026 6:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The first round of November Social Security payments for retirees, now capped at $5,181, will be issued in three days. 
 When will payments arrive?
 Retirees born on or before the 10th of a month will receive this payment on Tuesday, Nov. 10.

 The second round will go out on Nov. 18 to those born between the 11th and 20th of a month, and the third round will go out on Nov. 25 to those born on or after the 21st of a month. 
 Advertisement 
 When am I eligible?
 Citizens are eligible for Social Security payments beginning at age 62.
 How can I maximize my check?
 Social Security payment amounts are determined by several factors, including age of retirement, the amount paid into Social Security, and the number of years paid into Social Security.
 Payments largely depend on a recipient’s retirement age . A beneficiary retiring at the youngest age, 62, could receive up to $2,969 per month, while a 70-year-old retiree could receive up to $5,181 per month, according to the Social Security Administration.
 Advertisement Beneficiaries can see a personalized estimate of how much they could expect each month using the SSA’s calculator .

 How is it financed?
 Social Security is financed by a payroll tax paid for by employers and employees.
 Advertisement Social Security payment amounts are set to shrink unless Congress takes action to prevent it. According to a report from trustees, the retirement fund is set to run out by 2032 due to a rising number of retirees and a shrinking workforce.
